subject: general
question:
Which of the following parts of given URL is a 'domain name'?

http://www.india.in/tallybook/tallybook.xyz
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) www.india.in**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **www.india.in** is the domain name in the given URL.
 
• The domain name is a part of the URL that identifies a specific website or location on the internet.
 
• In this case, **www.india.in** is the unique address that directs to a specific website.
 
• The other parts of the URL, such as **http:**, **tallybook**, and **tallybook.xyz**, serve different purposes like protocol and paths within the website.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A domain name is crucial for navigating the internet, as it provides a human-readable address for accessing websites.
 
• Domain names are managed and regulated by organizations such as ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers).
 
• They are usually composed of a second-level domain (e.g., "india") and a top-level domain (e.g., ".in").
 
• Proper understanding of domain names is essential for web development, SEO, and digital marketing.
